# Auto spacing vectors (DESIGN §7.1). Every client's spacer must pass them.
#
#   events => the app's text afterwards
#
# Events are separated by "; ". Each vector starts with spacing on, an
# empty history, and an app whose text is empty and readable.
#
#   commit X    the engine commits X
#   key X       each character of X is typed and passed to the app
#   bs          Backspace (passed)
#   return      Return: the app inserts a line break, shown as ⏎
#   tab         Tab: the app inserts ⇥
#   esc, del    Escape, Forward Delete outside a composition
#   left, right arrow keys: the caret moves
#   cmd X       Command+X; cmd v pastes "P"
#   void X      a key outside the keymap (another layout) inserting X
#   click [N]   a mouse press; with N, the caret moves to N characters
#   switch      another app or window became active, sleep, Spaces
#   focus       a new text field (FocusIn)
#   idle        31 seconds without a key
#   text X      X appears in the app without the client seeing it
#   noread      the app can't report its text: tracking alone decides
#   stale       the app reports its text as it was before the last
#               insertion (Slack, Google Docs apply insertText late)
#   fakecaret   the app always reports the start of the text (Ghostty)
#   on, off     the engine's ResultAutoSpace
#   bs N, key   repeated: "bs 3"

# Boundaries, both ways, with letters and digits.
commit 中文; key abc => 中文 abc
key abc; commit 中文 => abc 中文
commit 用; key iPhone; commit 拍照 => 用 iPhone 拍照
commit 共; key 3; commit 个 => 共 3 个
commit 第; commit 3; commit 章 => 第 3 章
key 2026; commit 年 => 2026 年
commit 中文; commit hello => 中文 hello
commit hello; commit 中文 => hello 中文
commit 한국; key a => 한국 a
commit ひらがな; key a => ひらがな a
commit 中文; key é => 中文 é
commit 中文; commit αβ; commit Кириллица => 中文 αβКириллица

# No space next to spaces, punctuation and symbols, or between two of a kind.
commit 中文; key  a => 中文 a
key a ; commit 中文 => a 中文
commit 中文; commit ，; key a => 中文，a
commit 中文; key .a => 中文.a
key a.; commit 中文 => a.中文
commit 你好😀; key a => 你好😀a
commit 中文; commit 文字 => 中文文字
key ab; key cd => abcd
key a; commit iPhone手机 => aiPhone手机

# A commit is taken as given.
commit 2026年10月26日 => 2026年10月26日
commit 用iPhone拍照 => 用iPhone拍照
commit 中文; commit iPhone手机 => 中文 iPhone手机
commit 手机iPhone; commit 很好 => 手机iPhone 很好

# Off: nothing is inserted, but tracking goes on.
off; commit 中文; key a => 中文a
off; key a; commit 中文 => a中文
off; commit 中文; on; key a => 中文 a

# Backspace.
commit 中文; key a; bs; key b => 中文 b
commit 中文; key a; bs 2; key b => 中文b
commit 中文; key a; bs 2; key b; commit 好 => 中文b 好
commit 中文; key a; bs 3; key b => 中 b
noread; commit 中文; key ab; bs 2; key c => 中文 c
noread; commit 一二三四五六七八九十一二三四五六七; bs 16; key a => 一a
commit 一二三四五六七八九十一二三四五六七; bs 16; key a => 一 a
noread; commit 👍🏽; bs; commit 中文 => 中文
noread; commit 中文👍🏽; bs; key a => 中文a

# Resets. noread shows what tracking alone would do: nothing.
noread; key a; click; commit 中文 => a中文
noread; commit 中文; switch; key a => 中文a
noread; commit 中文; focus; key a => 中文a
noread; commit 中文; idle; key a => 中文a
noread; commit 中文; left; right; key a => 中文a
noread; commit 中文; cmd z; key a => 中文a
noread; commit 中文; cmd c; key a => 中文 a
noread; commit 中文; cmd s; key a => 中文 a
noread; commit 中文; cmd v; key a => 中文Pa
noread; commit 中文; esc; key a => 中文a
noread; commit 中文; del; key a => 中文a
noread; commit 中文; tab; key a => 中文⇥a
noread; commit 中文; return; key a => 中文⏎a
noread; commit 中文; return; bs; key a => 中文a
noread; commit 中文; void ü; key a => 中文üa

# Reading the app: after a reset it learns the left character.
key iPhone; click; commit 很好 => iPhone 很好
commit 中文; click; key a => 中文 a
commit 中文; idle; key a => 中文 a
commit 中文; cmd v; key a => 中文Pa
commit 中文; cmd v; commit 好 => 中文P 好
text iPhone; commit 很好 => iPhone 很好
noread; text iPhone; commit 很好 => iPhone很好
commit 中文; return; key a => 中文⏎a
commit 中文; left; key a => 中 a文
key ab; click 0; commit 中文 => 中文ab
key ab; click 1; commit 中文 => a 中文b

# Reading the app before a space: text the client didn't see wins.
commit 中文; text x; key a => 中文xa
commit 中文; text x; key a; commit 好 => 中文xa 好
noread; commit 中文; text x; key a => 中文x a
key a; text 文; commit 好 => a文好

# Apps that answer from before Shixin's last insertion: the tracking is
# right, so a mismatch with the earlier state isn't a correction.
stale; text 你好; commit 中文; commit ni; commit 里 => 你好中文 ni 里
stale; text 你好; commit 中文; key ab; commit 好 => 你好中文 ab 好
stale; commit 中文; text x; key a => 中文xa

# Apps that always report the start of the text: tracking decides, and
# after a reset nothing is spaced since the app can't be asked.
fakecaret; commit 中文; key a => 中文 a
fakecaret; commit 中文; click; key a => 中文a
fakecaret; commit 中文; key a; click; commit 好 => 中文 a好
